"""
The ODE system of the model `events_model`.

Written by sbmlode 0.3.3, SBML L3V2.

States x:

       id  name       unit
    1  V
    2  S   substrate
    3  P
    4  A
    5  B

`initial_values(p)` returns the initial states x0 and the constants p at t = 0,
`f!(dx, x, p, t)` the rates of change of the states and `f_y(x, p, t)` the assigned
values y, the rules and the reaction rates.
`EVENTS` lists the events with the functions of their delays, priorities and
assignments, `event_triggers(x, p, t)` and `event_conditions(x, p, t)` their triggers.
"""
module Events_model

export XIDS, PIDS, YIDS, NAMES, UNITS, P0, EVENTS, initial_values, f!, f_y, event_triggers,
    event_conditions

# the ids of the states x, the constants p and the assigned values y
const XIDS = [
    "V",
    "S",  # substrate
    "P",
    "A",
    "B",
]
const PIDS = [
    "c",
    "vmax",
    "km",
    "k1",
    "S0",
    "total",
]
const YIDS = [
    "dV_dt",  # rate of V
    "k2",
    "J0",
    "J1",
]

# the names and the units of the ids
const NAMES = Dict{String, Union{Nothing, String}}(
    "V" => nothing,
    "S" => "substrate",
    "P" => nothing,
    "A" => nothing,
    "B" => nothing,
    "c" => nothing,
    "vmax" => nothing,
    "km" => nothing,
    "k1" => nothing,
    "S0" => nothing,
    "total" => nothing,
    "dV_dt" => "rate of V",
    "k2" => nothing,
    "J0" => nothing,
    "J1" => nothing,
)
const UNITS = Dict{String, Union{Nothing, String}}(
    "V" => nothing,
    "S" => nothing,
    "P" => nothing,
    "A" => nothing,
    "B" => nothing,
    "c" => nothing,
    "vmax" => nothing,
    "km" => nothing,
    "k1" => nothing,
    "S0" => nothing,
    "total" => nothing,
    "dV_dt" => nothing,
    "k2" => nothing,
    "J0" => nothing,
    "J1" => nothing,
)

# the default values of the constants, `NaN` for one without a value, e.g. one which an
# initial assignment sets and `initial_values` computes
const P0 = [
    1.0,  # c
    2.0,  # vmax
    0.5,  # km
    0.1,  # k1
    10.0,  # S0
    0.0,  # total
]

mm(S, km) = S / (km + S)

"""
    initial_values(p=P0)

The initial states x0 and the constants p at t = 0.

The initial values, initial assignments and the rules they need are evaluated in the
order of their dependencies.

Every constant keeps the value passed.

Returns the initial states x0 and the constants p, a new vector.
"""
function initial_values(p::AbstractVector{<:Real}=P0)
    p = collect(Float64, p)
    # constants
    S0 = p[5]
    # initial values
    V = 2.0
    S = S0  # substrate
    P = 0.0
    A = 5.0
    B = 1.0
    x0 = Float64[V, S, P, A, B]
    return x0, p
end

"""
    f!(dx, x, p, t)

The rates of change dx/dt of the states x at the time t, written into dx.
"""
function f!(dx, x, p, t)
    # states
    V = x[1]
    S = x[2]  # substrate
    A = x[4]
    B = x[5]
    # constants
    c = p[1]
    vmax = p[2]
    km = p[3]
    k1 = p[4]
    # assigned values and reaction rates
    dV_dt = 0.1  # rate of V
    J0 = vmax * mm(S, km)
    J1 = k1 * S * A
    # rates of change
    dx[1] = 0.1  # dV/dt
    dx[2] = (-J0 - J1) / c  # dS/dt
    dx[3] = (J0 + 2.0 * J1) / c  # dP/dt
    dx[4] = -J1 / V - A / V * dV_dt  # dA/dt
    dx[5] = -0.1 * B  # dB/dt
    return nothing
end

"""
    f_y(x, p, t)

The assigned values y at the time t, the rules and the reaction rates.
"""
function f_y(x, p, t)
    # states
    S = x[2]  # substrate
    A = x[4]
    # constants
    vmax = p[2]
    km = p[3]
    k1 = p[4]
    # assigned values and reaction rates
    dV_dt = 0.1  # rate of V
    k2 = 2.0 * k1
    J0 = vmax * mm(S, km)
    J1 = k1 * S * A
    return Float64[dV_dt, k2, J0, J1]
end

"""
    event_triggers(x, p, t)

The root function of the trigger of each event, positive where it holds.

An integrator locates the time at which a trigger changes as a root of its function.
At a root, where the function is 0, the trigger itself decides, see
`event_conditions`: `a >= b` holds at `a == b`, `a > b` does not.
"""
function event_triggers(x, p, t)
    # states
    S = x[2]  # substrate
    return Float64[
        t - 5.0,  # E1 reset
        2.0 - S,  # E2
    ]
end

"""
    event_conditions(x, p, t)

Whether the trigger of each event holds.
"""
function event_conditions(x, p, t)
    # states
    S = x[2]  # substrate
    return Bool[
        t > 5.0,  # E1 reset
        S < 2.0,  # E2
    ]
end

"""
    event_priority_E1(x, p, t)

The priority of the event E1, evaluated before each execution.
"""
function event_priority_E1(x, p, t)
    return 1.0
end

"""
    event_values_E1(x, p, t)

The values the event E1 assigns, evaluated when its trigger turns true.
"""
function event_values_E1(x, p, t)
    # states
    V = x[1]
    return Float64[
        2.0 * V,  # V
        10.0,  # S substrate
        NaN,  # A: not assigned, its amount is kept
        NaN,  # B: not assigned, its amount is kept
    ]
end

"""
    event_sizes_E1(x, p, t)

The sizes of the compartments the event E1 changes, after its assignments.
"""
function event_sizes_E1(x, p, t)
    # states
    V = x[1]
    return Float64[V]
end

"""
    event_assign_E1(x, p, t, values)

Execute the event E1: the states x and the constants p with the values, new vectors.

A concentration in a compartment whose size the event changes keeps its amount: it is
scaled with the size before the event and divided by the size after it,
`event_sizes_E1`, evaluated with the values the event assigned.
"""
function event_assign_E1(x, p, t, values)
    # states
    V = x[1]
    A = x[4]
    B = x[5]
    x = copy(x)
    p = copy(p)
    x[1] = values[1]  # V
    x[2] = values[2]  # S substrate
    sizes = event_sizes_E1(x, p, t)
    x[4] = A * V / sizes[1]  # A
    x[5] = B * V / sizes[1]  # B
    return x, p
end

"""
    event_delay_E2(x, p, t)

The delay of the event E2, evaluated when its trigger turns true.
"""
function event_delay_E2(x, p, t)
    return 1.0
end

"""
    event_values_E2(x, p, t)

The values the event E2 assigns, evaluated when its trigger turns true.
"""
function event_values_E2(x, p, t)
    # constants
    total = p[6]
    return Float64[
        1.0,  # A
        total + 1.0,  # total
    ]
end

"""
    event_assign_E2(x, p, t, values)

Execute the event E2: the states x and the constants p with the values, new vectors.
"""
function event_assign_E2(x, p, t, values)
    x = copy(x)
    p = copy(p)
    x[4] = values[1]  # A
    p[6] = values[2]  # total
    return x, p
end

# the events in the order of the model: their flags and the functions of their delay,
# priority and assignments; the trigger of EVENTS[k] is the entry k of `event_triggers`
# and `event_conditions`
const EVENTS = [
    (
        id = "E1",
        initial_value = true,
        persistent = true,
        use_trigger_values = true,
        delay = nothing,
        priority = event_priority_E1,
        values = event_values_E1,
        assign = event_assign_E1,
    ),
    (
        id = "E2",
        initial_value = true,
        persistent = true,
        use_trigger_values = true,
        delay = event_delay_E2,
        priority = nothing,
        values = event_values_E2,
        assign = event_assign_E2,
    ),
]

end  # module Events_model
